_note: Istruzioni del Dust Storm Round per le Fazioni Non-Player (§8.5.9), trascritte dalla scheda «NP Dust Storm Round Instructions». I nomi delle colonne sono quelli di np_priorities.json; le voci con `only_if_player` valgono solo se quella Fazione è di un giocatore, quelle con `when` solo se la condizione è vera. Le istruzioni `get` sono numerate come sulla scheda ed eseguite in ordine.

victory._note: Un umano in solitario contro tre Fazioni NP può vincere solo all'ultimo Dust Storm Round.

corporations.label: NP CORP is EG Controller: place all EG Troops on Phobos

marsgov.label: NP MG is EG Controller: 4 EG Troops to each MG Base, the rest on Phobos

keep.label: keep MG forces to exceed CORP forces in Populated spaces at Support with a CORP Base
keep 3 cubes in each space with Support (if possible)

origin_order.label: Troops in Deserts without a COIN Base first
then one at a time from spaces with the most Troops

get.label: get COIN forces to exceed Rebel forces in Labyrinths and in all Deserts with an MG Base
get 4 cubes to each Desert with an MG Base
get MG forces to exceed CORP forces in each space at Support with a CORP Base
move any Troops still in Deserts without a COIN Base

keep.label: keep 3 RD Rebels in each space with room for an Available RD Base
keep 1 RD Rebel in each Populated space without Active Opposition (if possible)

origin_order.label: Rebels in Deserts without Opposition or an RD Base first
then one at a time from spaces with the most RD Rebels

get.label: get 1 RD Rebel to each space with an RD Base
get 3 RD Rebels to each space with room for an Available RD Base
move any Rebels still in Deserts without Opposition or an RD Base

keep.label: keep 3 CR Rebels in each space with room for an Available CR Base
keep 1 CR Rebel in all other spaces

origin_order.label: one at a time from spaces with the most CR Rebels

get.label: move 1 CR Base to the Wilderness from all other spaces with 2 CR Bases
get 1 CR Rebel to each space with a CR Base
get 3 CR Rebels to each space with room for an Available CR Base

reset._note: Rimescola il mazzo Curiosity. Se l'Agitate Total di NP RD è 0, riportalo a 1d3.
